# Editing a board card keeps its shape: in place and in the editor

## Context

Driving #21630 (the board's card-editing example) on `dev` `5851f7d976` at 1440 × 900 in neo-dark found two places where a board card loses its shape while it is edited, and a cold read of the example's frames found a third. #21630's ACs require the first ("The card does not change its size while it is edited"), and its look AC reads the open editor cold. That ticket keeps engine changes out of its PR, so this leaf blocks it.

## The Problem

1. **The inline edit grows the card.** A card is 91.1 px tall, and 95.9 px while its title is edited. The title's line box is 18.2 px (14 px at `line-height: 1.3`), and the `Neo.form.field.Text` that replaces it is 27 px. `margin: -2px 0` takes back only 4 px. The edited name also drops to the field's 13 px from the title's 14 px semibold, so the text jumps as the edit starts.
2. **The editor labels its fields two ways.** The Status field is a `Neo.form.field.Select`, a native select whose label always sits above it, while every text field labels on its left. The dialog reads as two forms stacked together.
3. **The editor can open for one card while another stays highlighted.** The `⋯` button opens the editor without touching the selection. After a candidate is renamed (which selects that card), opening another candidate's editor leaves the first one highlighted, so the editor looks like it is changing the wrong record.

## The Architectural Reality

- `.neo-board-card-inline-editor` (`resources/css/src/board/Card.css:57-61`) sizes the inline field next to `.neo-board-card-title` (`:51-55`). The field's own CSS gives it `height: 27px`, and its input `min-height: 25px` and 13 px type.
- `CardEditor#getStandardFieldConfigs` (`src/board/CardEditor.mjs:526`) and `#createModelFieldConfig` build Text, TextArea, Number and Date fields with no `labelPosition`, so they take Text's `labelPosition_: 'left'` (`src/form/field/Text.mjs:200`). `Neo.form.field.Select` has no `labelPosition`, and its label is a block above the control.
- `SelectionModel#onBoardClick` (`src/board/SelectionModel.mjs`) returns early for a click on `.neo-board-card-menu-button`, and `Card#onMenuButtonClick` opens the editor directly.
- Design authority: none found. Searched the `Card.mjs`, `CardEditor.mjs` and `SelectionModel.mjs` JSDoc, `learn/guides`, and #21371 / #21222 (the earlier editor tickets: contrast, and the model-driven fields). No record makes the growth, the mixed labels or the stale highlight intended.

## The Fix

1. Give the inline edit the title's line box and type: the field takes `height: auto` and the title's weight and line height, and its input takes `font: inherit`, `height: 1lh` and no minimum. The card keeps its height, and the name keeps its font.
2. Label the editor's text-like fields on top, as the select already is, in the configs both methods build. A config that names its own `labelPosition` keeps it.
3. A `⋯` click on an unselected card makes it the selection. A selected card keeps the selection it belongs to.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A card keeps its height while its title is edited, and the edited name keeps the title's font. A component spec measures both, and it fails on `dev`.
- [ ] Every field of the card editor carries its label above it. A unit arm reads `labelPosition: 'top'` on the Title, Assignees, Tags, Description, Progress and Date configs.
- [ ] A `⋯` click on an unselected card makes that card the selection, and on a selected card it keeps the selection (unit arm in `SelectionModel.spec.mjs`, failing on `dev`).
- [ ] The board unit family and `test/playwright/e2e/board/` stay green.

## Out of Scope

The example (#21630). The select's own label options. Fields an app passes as full configs through `fields`. The dialog's header colors and modal mask (theme-wide dialog styles).

## Avoided Traps

- **Shrinking the field with a negative margin sized to one theme's input.** Input heights differ per theme; `1lh` follows the title.
- **Moving the select's label to the left.** A 440 px dialog has no room for a label column, and top labels also fit a phone.
- **Collapsing a multi-selection to the card whose `⋯` was clicked.** A selected card's menu keeps the selection it belongs to.
